purpose: Fixed expected-result candidates created before WP8 implementation. Engine output must not be used to alter them.

review.notes: All 53 fixtures independently reviewed against cited official sources for applicability, arithmetic, rounding, semantics and deliberate limitations. HICBC fixtures were re-derived after identifying an incomplete prior interpretation of staged section 681C(3) rounding; RW3-HICBC-004 and RW3-HICBC-012 were corrected from 1392 to 1391. See docs/RW3_V1_PREIMPLEMENTATION_FORMAL_REVIEW.md.

rounding: Monetary liabilities fixed to pounds and pence except HICBC, for which the relevant total Child Benefit amount, percentage and calculated charge are each rounded down at their statutory stage under ITEPA 2003 s681C(3). Dividend literals avoid fractional-penny ambiguity. No periodic PAYE or student-loan rounding is inferred from these fixtures.
